किंग खान शाह रुख खान अपने ही घर में कुछ भी करने के लिए आजाद नहीं हैं! 😲

11 November को Dubai Maritime City में Shahrukhz by Danube प्रोजेक्ट के लॉन्च इवेंट में शाह रुख खान ने अपनी फैमिली डायनामिक्स पर बेहद मजेदार बातें शेयर कीं।
इवेंट में होस्ट Karan Johar ने जब शाह रुख से पूछा कि घर में उन्हें क्या करने की इजाजत नहीं है, तो एक्टर ने हंसते हुए कहा कि उन्हें अपने ही घर में कुछ भी करने की अनुमति नहीं है।
शाह रुख ने मजाक उड़ाते हुए कहा कि Gauri Khan के डिजाइन किए घर में वो, Aryan और Suhana न तो WiFi की शिकायत कर सकते हैं, न बेड पर खा सकते हैं और न ही घर के कलर्स या पेंटिंग्स पर कमेंट कर सकते हैं।
इसी इवेंट में शाह रुख ने अपनी आने वाली फिल्म King का पावरफुल डायलॉग "मैं डर नहीं, दहशत हूं" सुनाकर माहौल बना दिया। Siddharth Anand के डायरेक्शन में बन रही फिल्म King से उनकी बेटी Suhana Khan भी थियेट्रिकल डेब्यू कर रही हैं। 🎬✨

क्या आपके घर में भी गौरी खान की तरह सख्त नियम चलते हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Shah Rukh Khan jokes about Gauri Khan's house rules, says he is not allowed to complain about anything in their home
ctx.summary: At a Dubai property launch, Shah Rukh Khan joked about the rules Gauri Khan has set for their home and how he is not allowed to criticise anything about it.
ctx.text:
Shah Rukh Khan charmed everyone with his trademark humour and wit at the launch of Shahrukhz by Danube, his branded residential project at Dubai Maritime City, on November 11. A video from the event has been doing the rounds on social media, in which the actor joked about his family dynamics with wife Gauri Khan and their children. The project features penthouses designed by Gauri.
During the event, filmmaker Karan Johar , who hosted the evening, asked Shah Rukh about one thing he was still not allowed to do in his own home.
“I am not allowed to do anything in my own house,” Shah Rukh replied, drawing loud laughter from the audience.
Shah Rukh went on to joke that he and his children were not allowed to criticise anything about their home, which is designed by Gauri.
“In our house, we cannot say anything about Gauri's home. We cannot complain about the WiFi, nor are we allowed to eat in bed. We cannot comment on the colours, paintings, stairs, lift, ceiling, or lighting. We simply sit quietly and enjoy the house, saying, 'What a house you have built, Gauri.' Now my problem is that when I visit the penthouse here, I will have to say the same thing—'What a penthouse you have built, Gauri!' Outside the house, we are free; Aryan, Suhana, and I have a blast. Inside the house, we cannot do anything,” he added.
The banter continued when Karan playfully asked whether Shah Rukh was more scared of business, the box office or his wife. The actor, however, pointed out that Karan had forgotten his signature dialogue from his upcoming film King. He then recreated the dialogue on stage - "Hazaar mulko me badnaam aur duniya ne diya ek hi naam. Aur wo pata hai kyun? Kyunki main darr nahi, dehshat hoon" (Notorious across a thousand countries, yet the world gave only one name. And do you know why? Because I am not fear, I am terror)." This left the audience cheering for him.
A post shared by Rai Fyham - Dubai Real Estate (@fyham.rai)
Shah Rukh Khan will next be seen in King, directed by Siddharth Anand. The action thriller also stars his daughter Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji and Abhay Verma, among others. The film marks Shah Rukh and Siddharth's reunion after their blockbuster Pathaan.
The film is particularly special as it marks Suhana's theatrical debut alongside her father. She had earlier made her acting debut with Zoya Akhtar's Netflix film The Archies in 2023.
